clubInfo.name: KU Math Club
clubInfo.mission: To foster a vibrant community of mathematical thinkers, innovators, and problem-solvers who contribute meaningfully to the advancement of mathematical knowledge and its applications in real-world scenarios.
clubInfo.vision: To be the leading mathematics club in Nepal, recognized for producing outstanding mathematical minds who contribute to global scientific advancement and social progress.
